phase3.mix.sidechainLegend: Lower one track when another plays
phase3.mix.sidechainHint: When the trigger track’s volume rises above the chosen level, Song Maker lowers the other track. The second setting controls how much.
phase3.mix.sidechainEmpty: No automatic volume reduction is set up.
phase3.mix.sidechainMissingTrack: One of the selected tracks is no longer in this song.
phase3.mix.sidechainNeedTracks: Add at least two tracks to use automatic volume reduction.
phase3.mix.loudnessNote: This reports the song’s final volume. It does not change the sound.
phase3.mix.loudnessNeedStems: Split the song into tracks first to measure its final volume.
clips.tempoHint: Tempo changes do not alter source files or clip offsets; playback and export remain in milliseconds.
clips.markerShiftClips: Move clips with the marker (without changing the source)
production.edit.title: Clip editing
production.edit.select.hint: V: select and move. Edges trim the clip; the fields below accept values in ms.
production.edit.cut.hint: C: click to split. X splits at the playback position inside the clip, or its midpoint otherwise.
production.edit.fade.hint: F: drag in the left or right half to adjust the fade. Fade fields also accept values in ms.
production.edit.marker.hint: M: click the Markers lane or a clip to place a marker.
production.select.needClip: Select a clip to move it.
production.cut.needClip: Select a clip to split it.
production.cut.midpoint: Playback position outside the clip: splitting at midpoint.
production.fade.needClip: Select a clip to adjust fades.
production.playhead.back: Move playback position one step back
production.playhead.forward: Move playback position one step forward
production.addTrack.menuHint: Import an audio file, record a track, or create an instrumental part.
production.fade.error.tooLong: Fade in and fade out together are longer than the clip duration.
production.fade.error.negative: Fade length must be zero or positive.
phase3.mix.vocalFx.vocalsOnly: Voice cleanup, pitch correction, and tone adjustment only apply to vocal tracks. Disable the effect to hear the original track again.
phase3.mix.pitchCorrect.vocalsOnly: Pitch correction only applies to vocal tracks. Disable this effect to hear the original track again.
phase3.mix.pitchCorrect.honesty: This makes a light correction to the vocal pitch. Turn it off to compare with the original.
phase3.mix.voiceCleanup.honesty: Reduces background noise in a voice recording. If consonants become less clear, lower the strength or increase “Preserve consonants”. You can change or remove this effect at any time.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.consent: I confirm this is my voice and agree to modify it.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.needsConsent: Confirm that the recording contains your own voice.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.notShipped: This feature makes a slight tone adjustment based on a recording of your voice. It does not create a full copy of your voice.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.needsReference: Choose a WAV file containing your voice to set the reference tone.
phase3.mix.voiceConvert.ready: Reference ready. The tone adjustment is subtle.
phase3.mix.voiceDenoise.honesty: Reduces background noise. If the voice loses clarity, lower the strength.
phase3.mix.param.eqBandsHint: Bands with curve type, frequency, gain, and Q — separate from the shelf EQ.
phase3.mix.param.delayHint: Without a valid tempo, delay uses free time in ms. Feedback is capped to avoid runaway feedback.

mix.assist.title: Mix starting points
production.mixSettings.gridHint: Snap and zoom live here — not on a separate bar.
production.vst3.hint: Processes the complete mix offline. The same result is used for playback preview and export; it does not affect live recording.
production.vst3.noPlugins: No VST3 effects found in the standard Windows folders. Install a VST3 effect, then search again.
production.vst3.notWindows: VST3 effects are currently available in the Windows version.
production.vst3.parametersHint: Names and units depend on each effect.
production.vst3.notEffect: This is an instrument plugin. Choose an audio effect with an audio input.
production.vst3.anatomyWorkflow: ANATOMY processes a WAV loaded in its own window: open the plugin, drop in a WAV, export the result there, then import that WAV into Production. It is a sound-design workflow, not a regular mix effect.
production.vst3.editorWaiting: Plugin window open — close it to apply changes…
production.vst3.needsStems: Separate the take into tracks before enabling an effect.
production.vst3.missing: The saved plugin is not in the scan results. Reinstall it or select another effect.
production.vst3.noParameters: This effect does not expose adjustable controls to Song Maker.

production.separate.disabledBusy: Operation in progress — try again in a moment.
production.separate.disabledNoGeneration: No active take — generate or select a version before separating.

production.fx.noneSelected: Select an effect to edit its properties.
production.track.clipNone: No clip selected on this track.
production.eq.missing: Add a parametric EQ in the effect chain to edit bands here.
production.instrumental.title: New instrumental part
production.instrumental.intro: Choose an instrument and what should guide its creation. The new track will be added to your arrangement.
production.instrumental.conditioning.met: The song’s style, tempo and key
production.instrumental.legoHonesty: The result may contain several instruments. The track starts at the beginning of the song; you can move it afterwards. The original song’s licence restrictions still apply.
production.instrumental.generate: Generate and add to the arrangement
production.track.auto.hint: The automation curve appears under the track when the option is on.
production.auto.locked: Unlock the track to edit its automation curve.
production.auto.empty: No points: the track setting remains active.
qwen.mix.title: Local mix assistant
qwen.mix.modelMissing: The configured model is missing. Install it on the local LLM server and try again.
qwen.mix.needStems: Separate the song into tracks in Production to analyze their levels.
qwen.mix.stale: The mix changed after this analysis. Analyse again before confirming.
qwen.mix.serviceMissing: Start the local LLM server on this computer and try again.
qwen.mix.remoteBlocked: Remote servers are disabled. Enable expert cloud mode, or use a local address.
qwen.mix.invalid: The model returned invalid settings. No settings were applied.
qwen.mix.totalMeasured: Complete analysis, including track decoding: {time} s.
qwen.mix.failed: The local model could not finish this analysis. Check the LLM server and try again.
qwen.mix.confirm: Confirm these gain and pan changes?
qwen.mix.rationale: Settings proposed from measured track levels.
qwen.mix.local: The assistant analyses measured track levels on this computer. Audio and summaries stay on this computer unless expert cloud mode is enabled. The model must be available on the configured LLM server.
qwen.mix.licenseNotice: Apache-2.0 · Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud. The weights are installed separately on the local LLM server. The license text is available here, offline.
qwen.mix.title: Local mix assistant
qwen.mix.llamaCpp.hint: Phase 2b: Song Maker talks to llama-server over the OpenAI API (/v1). llama.cpp is not downloaded or started here. Start the server yourself, then set the loopback URL.
qwen.mix.external.hint: Phase 2c: already-running server only. Song Maker does not download a binary or weights.
qwen.mix.rbitnet.weightsNotInInstaller: Product decision: Rbitnet / GGUF weights are not in the installer (MSI or otherwise). Download them here, or use an external server.
qwen.mix.rbitnet.jsonQuality: BitNet vs Qwen JSON quality: unmeasured. The validator (IDs, gain/pan bounds) is the same; that says nothing about BitNet proposal quality.
qwen.mix.leftovers.title: Still open (#336)
qwen.mix.leftovers.weights: Weights outside the installer: decided and shown (deferred download).
qwen.mix.leftovers.e2e: Windows e2e proof with actually downloaded weights: not done here.
qwen.mix.leftovers.json: BitNet vs Qwen JSON quality comparison: not measured.
qwen.mix.leftovers.llama: Phase 2b llama.cpp: OpenAI-compat HTTP backend, no bundled llama.cpp binary.
qwen.mix.leftovers.external: Phase 2c external-only: dedicated provider, no sidecar.
qwen.mix.leftovers.foundry: Phase 3 Foundry Local / WinML: not shipped.
qwen.mix.allowRemote: Expert mode: allow a remote (cloud) server
qwen.mix.allowRemoteWarn: Track summaries will leave this computer. Off by default.
qwen.mix.serverSaveFailed: Could not save the LLM server.
qwen.mix.rbitnet.hint: Rbitnet sidecar: binary and weights download on demand (not in the MSI).
qwen.mix.rbitnet.binaryFailed: Could not download the Rbitnet binary.
qwen.mix.rbitnet.startFailed: Could not start the Rbitnet sidecar.
qwen.mix.rbitnet.needWeights: Download the Rbitnet model weights first.
midi.output.title: MIDI output
midi.output.hint: Send the selected score voice to a synthesizer or virtual MIDI port. Channel and program numbers start at 1.
midi.output.osLimit: Native proofs: Windows GS Wavetable only. macOS (CoreMIDI) and Linux (ALSA) are compiled, not hardware-tested in this repo. Windows USB: unverified.
midi.output.error: The MIDI output is unavailable. Find outputs and reconnect the port.
midi.output.empty: Find outputs after connecting your synthesizer or virtual port.
clips.hint: Drag a clip to move it, its edges to trim it, and its handles to adjust fades. Alt+click to split. Use arrow keys to nudge. Musical or time grid.
basicPitch.hint: Detected notes will be added to Score, where you can correct them.
basicPitch.quality.vocals: The detected melody can be a starting point; check for sudden pitch jumps.
basicPitch.quality.bass: The detected bass line can be a useful starting point.
basicPitch.quality.piano: Piano notes are difficult to isolate in a full song.
basicPitch.quality.drums: Detected drum notes are not reliable yet.
basicPitch.quality.other: Accuracy varies by instrument; check the suggested notes.
basicPitch.noAudio: Import or generate audio on this track first.
licenses.basicPitch: BasicPitch (spotify/basic-pitch, nmp.onnx) — Apache 2.0; ONNX runtime, no TensorFlow
production.mixSettings.needTracks: Separate the song or add a track to adjust the mix.
production.instrumental.installRequired: To use the song’s sound as a guide, install the audio model and accept its licence. Tracks are created one at a time.
production.instrumental.needAudio: Separate the song or import a track to use your audio.
production.instrumental.previewHelp: The result may contain only the new part, or also your original song. Listen before adding it.
production.instrumental.fullMixHelp: “Complete song” mutes the other tracks to avoid doubling them. They are kept and can be enabled again.
production.instrumental.previewMissing: The new part’s audio file could not be found. Your arrangement is preserved.
settings.model.lego.available: The model is ready. It will start automatically when you create a track from your song.
settings.model.lego.incomplete: The installation is incomplete. Try again to repair it.
settings.model.lego.absent: The model is not installed yet.
settings.model.lego.firstUse: The first time, Song Maker downloads extra files automatically. Allow several gigabytes and extra setup time.
